bio: The Waldenmaier family (now in its fourth generation) cooks excellent regional fare with seasonal produce. A variety of three-course set menus is available, including one that is vegetarian and one featuring fish. Dishes can also be ordered à la carte or mixed and matched as desired. Additionally, there are one or two special recommendations. What's more, they hunt their own game and distil their own schnapps! While chef-patron Sven cooks, Simone provides cordial service. This cosy and charmingly decorated restaurant is located on the first floor, as is the gorgeous balcony terrace....
